Don’t miss this little gem of a resturant
Jan 2026 • Couples
So we stumbled upon this place by chance. We decided to give it a go and was so glad we did one of the newer Indians restaurants. The food was excellent and decent portions sizes to, we had the butter chicken vindaloo hot outstanding perfect for my pallet and lots of depth to the curry without being to heavy. My wife had the vindaloo again perfect heat for here potatoes and Chicken were so soft and succulent. The garlic Nan was lovely and thin not doughy like some others I won’t mention well priced and lovely friendly staff unlike really hot curry’s so when I asked the waiter for some fresh green chilis. He was happy to oblige. Can’t wait to get back to try another dish.
